dominant_strengths: Exquisite 3D render of glass-morphic UI primitives with technical drafting marks signals craft and the Liquid Glass design language authentically
Restrained Apple-native chrome (black nav, SF type, generous whitespace) lets the hero artwork carry visceral weight without competing
Rainbow gradient toggle anchors the composition with a single saturated focal point against a near-monochrome field
dominant_weaknesses: Headline typography is undersized and centered low in the frame, feeling like a caption rather than a leading statement against the massive hero
Sub-nav (Overview/What's New/Get Started) competes visually with the primary global nav, creating two stacked dark bars that flatten hierarchy
Hero asset is beautiful but generic Apple house style — little distinctiveness beyond what WWDC marketing already established
fix_priorities: Scale up and reposition the headline so the value proposition leads, not trails, the artwork
Differentiate the sub-nav (lighter fill, thinner divider) to break the double-bar weight
Introduce a distinctive editorial moment unique to Design (not reused marketing render) to earn distinctiveness
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral dominates via the seductive glass render, behavioral is adequate but hierarchy-muddled, and reflective payoff is weakened by a small headline burying the meaning.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads convincingly as the Apple Developer Design hub and showcases the design language it preaches, but the page underuses typography to communicate purpose.
